business_scope.primary_industry_name: High-End Loose-Leaf Tea Service and Cultural Ceramic Salons

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Codigo de Comercio Decreto Ley 410 de 1971, Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF creation), Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT framework), Ley 2010 de 2019 and DIAN Resolucion 000164 de 2020 (tax beneficial ownership reporting), Decreto 830 de 2021 and related DIAN regulations (Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF), Superintendencia de Sociedades SAGRILAFT Circular Basica Juridica requirements, and Ley 1437 de 2011 (administrative procedure code applicable to registry appeals).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of UBO declaration and shareholding structure
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin or Cámara de Comercio

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney for local incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of shareholders, directors, and legal representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public passport authority or Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Good Standing for corporate shareholder (if applicable)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners against (i) the UIAF consolidated PEP list and Colombian criminal-record databases, (ii) the OFAC SDN List, (iii) the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, (iv) the Colombian Government SIRI tax-risk list, and (v) EU and UK financial sanctions lists; continuous monitoring must be implemented and all screening results documented in the compliance file and retained for a period not less than ten years under UIAF standards.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES) via the local Cámara de Comercio and the Superintendencia de Sociedades online name-reservation module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate denomination must be expressed in Spanish or in transliterated Latin script consistent with Spanish phonetics; the legal entity suffix 'S.A.S.' is mandatory; names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and must not contain foreign-characters, symbols, or misleading terms absent statutory justification.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written reconsideration petition with the competent Cámara de Comercio within five business days; if the reconsideration is denied, an administrative appeal must be lodged before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within ten business days under Ley 1437 de 2011, attaching the original rejection notice and supporting evidence of distinctiveness and lawful use.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for this specific scope. A specialty tea salon and lounge under ISIC 5630 requires a physical commercial establishment registered with the municipal use-of-soil and sanitary authorities; a virtual-only registered address will be rejected by the Cámara de Comercio and DIAN for the purpose of operational licensure, although supplementary administrative correspondence may be directed to the legal representative's physical office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% annual likelihood (Low to Moderate); municipal health, fire-safety, and consumer-protection audits are scheduled, while unannounced DIAN or UIAF on-site inspections are uncommon for low-risk standard retail-service activities.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Régimen de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-48; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110-125 (mercantile registration); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (regulatory decrees of incorporation procedure)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la jurisdicción corporativa (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (or escritura pública if required) with the Bylaws of the S.A.S.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital under Ley 1258 de 2008. The incorporator fixes the authorized capital freely; the subscribed capital may be payable in installments for a term not exceeding two years. No escrow account is legally mandated; cash subscriptions are evidenced by a bank deposit certificate or asset appraisal filed with the Chamber of Commerce.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE SOCIEDAD POR ACCIONES SIMPLIFICADA [COMPANY NAME]: The incorporator, acting under Ley 1258 de 2008 and the Bylaws, resolves: 1. Share Subscription — the authorized capital is subscribed and distributed as stated in the subscription schedule, with payment terms within the statutory limit. 2. Registered Office — the corporate seat is fixed at the address declared in the incorporation document. 3. Officers — the undersigned appoints the Principal Manager and the Alternate Manager with full corporate, banking, and tax powers. 4. The Manager is authorized to complete NIT/RUT registration, commercial filing, and municipal license formalities. Meeting closed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la jurisdicción — Portal RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the RUES portal and complete the Formulario de Homoclave. Submit three alternative corporate names for the S.A.S.; the system verifies identical or similar names in the national commercial registry. Once approved, download the 'Certificado de Homonimia' valid for 30 calendar days. No notarization is required at this stage.
required_dossiers: Formulario de Homoclave (RUES)
Cédula de ciudadanía or passport of the incorporator
Draft bylaw names and activity description (ISIC 5630)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, the system automatically evaluates the next alternative. If all are rejected, a new application is filed; an existing reservation can be objected via the chamber's 'recurso de reposición' within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (when required) / Cámara de Comercio (private instrument filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, including the corporate purpose for 'operación de salón de té, servicio de bebidas calientes, pastelería fina y venta de hojas de té', the authorized capital, the registered seat, the term, and the mandatory statutory clauses of Ley 1258 de 2008. All shareholders sign the document before a notary when the transferred assets exceed the chamber's threshold or when real property is contributed; otherwise, signatures shall be recognized (autenticadas) at the chamber.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Homonimia
Cédulas / passports of all shareholders
Project of bylaws (proyecto de estatutos)
Certificado de uso de suelo of the premises
Poder especial if signed by a legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The notary or chamber identifies omissions of mandatory clauses. The incorporator amends the document and re-presents it within 30 days; the name reservation remains effective.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration and Payment of Registration Tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la jurisdicción (RUES online or physical window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed incorporation instrument together with Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial (FUR). Pay the 'derechos de inscripción' calculated by the Chamber's tariff table and the national 'impuesto de registro' (0.7% of capital subscribed up to legal ceilings). Upon registration, obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which is the conclusive proof of legal incorporation.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución (notarized if applicable)
Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial - FUR
Receipts of payment of registration rights and impuesto de registro
Certificado de Homonimia
Pre-registry compliance list (diligenciamiento previo)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a 'requerimiento de corrección', the incorporator has 30 calendar days to cure the defect and resubmit; after expiration without cure, the file is archived and a new registration is opened.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Regime Registration (NIT/RUT) and Electronic Signature with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — sede electrónica (dian.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the existence certificate is issued, the legal representative registers the company in the RUT portal, obtaining the NIT. Select the tax responsibilities (Régimen Ordinario, IVA responsibility if annual sales exceed thresholds, or optional declaration), request the digital signature certificate, and enable electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) mandatory for the operation of the tea salon.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT registration form (Formulario 2021)
ID of legal representative and certified email
Bylaws and incorporation document
Proof of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Inconsistencies between the Chamber record and DIAN data suspend the RUT process. The representative corrects the RUES filings or Chamber certificate and re-files the RUT application; the initial suspension may be lifted by DIAN within 10 days upon full alignment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Employer Security Affiliation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank (of company selection) and security entities: EPS, Pension Administradora, ARL, Caja de Compensación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account presenting the existence certificate, NIT/RUT, and board resolution. Because the activity is classified AML low-risk, complete standard KYC and source-of-funds documentation. Register the company as employer and the employees with the social security system before operational start-up: EPS (health), pension fund, ARL, and Caja de Compensación; the ARL requires the ISIC 5630 activity code to issue the occupation-accident coverage certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT / NIT
Board resolution appointing officers and authorizing bank accounts
AML/KYC form and signature card (tarjeta de firmas)
ARL, EPS, and pension affiliation forms
Lease or ownership title of the commercial premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A bank may escalate enhanced due diligence; the company provides a sworn statement of sources of funds and economic activity. If the ARL refuses because the activity is misregistered, the Chamber can issue a corrected existence certificate specifying ISIC 5630, and the ARL re-issues coverage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Land Use and Operating Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría de Planeación Municipal / Alcaldía Local (with technical review of Secretaría de Salud and Cuerpo de Bomberos)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for the Certificado de Uso de Suelo for the commercial premises. The municipality assesses zoning compatibility for a tea salon lounge (ISIC 5630), public assembly limits, and parking/accessibility requirements. Simultaneously, request the Concepto Sanitario from the local health secretariat and the fire-fighting inspection. These documents form the municipal operating license ('Licencia de Funcionamiento') for the commercial establishment.
required_dossiers: Lease or property title of the premises
Architectural plan and location plan (plano de localización)
Certificado de Uso de Suelo application
Concepto Sanitario (health clearance) for food-service outlets
Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety inspection)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the zoning concept is unfavorable, the applicant may file a reconsideration within 10 days or apply for an exceptional-use license (licencia de localización y funcionamiento) showing the low-impact nature of the tea lounge. For sanitary or fire requirements, corrective measures are implemented and the relevant authority re-inspects the premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Salud / Secretaría de Salud Municipal (health surveillance) and Alcaldía Local — Secretaría de Gobierno (municipal operating license)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Funcionamiento de Establecimiento de Comercio y Concepto Sanitario para Expendio de Alimentos y Bebidas (Tea Salon/Lounge)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for national cases; Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente / CAR (Corporación Autónoma Regional) for municipal low-impact registration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-impact Environmental Registry ('Registro de Bajos Impactos Ambientales') — not a full Environmental Impact Assessment. As a service establishment of ISIC 5630, the activity is exempt from a complete EIA study but must file the 'Plan de Gestión Integral de Residuos Sólidos' and a discharge registration with the municipal environmental authority.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: comply with Resolución 631 de 2015 (BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, grease/oils ≤ 20 mg/L) for discharges to the public sewer. Indoor air: meet municipal odor and ventilation limits, with kitchen/hood capture efficiency ≥ 95% for local extract systems. Solid waste: separate used tea leaves and organic residues, store in approved containers, and deliver to licensed waste carriers under Decreto 1076 de 2015.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos issues the Certificado de Bomberos after verifying fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and kitchen ventilation; structural load adequacy must be confirmed by a registered engineer (memoria de cálculo estructural) where the lounge is on elevated floors; occupational safety and health (SG-SST) program must be in place and the company affiliated with an ARL before opening to the public.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); main portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic services via the MUISCA platform (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Control Automatizado), including the mandatory electronic invoicing system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Colombian S.A.S. must first complete notarial and Chamber of Commerce registration, then obtain the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) and NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through the DIAN portal, under the MUISCA platform, before commencing any taxable operations. Non-resident shareholders are not required to obtain a local NIT unless they derive Colombian-source income subject to tax; in such cases, registration by the foreign taxpayer may be effected through a duly empowered representative or legal agent in Colombia.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the S.A.S. is a Colombian tax-resident corporation taxed on worldwide income; corporate income tax headline rate of 35%, plus a 3% surcharge on taxable income exceeding approximately COP 1.2 billion; dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are subject to dividend withholding tax and, for dividends from earnings subject to corporate tax, an additional assessed tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime is available in Colombia; entity classification is determined solely by legal form and tax residence, and no elective passthrough treatment exists for a Colombian S.A.S. Hybrid mismatch considerations are governed by the OECD Multilateral Instrument and the Andean Community rules, but Colombian domestic law does not grant elective hybrid mismatch status to domestic or cross-border entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0: no general turnover threshold for IVA registration; any individual or legal entity, resident or foreign, that performs taxable activities in the national territory, including foreign suppliers of digital services to Colombian consumers, must enroll in the RUT and be registered as an IVA responsible party. Limited simplified rules apply to occasional taxpayers and small artisan sellers, but are not applicable to a regular S.A.S. engaged in the sale of specialty tea in a fixed salon.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory for all VAT-responsible taxpayers: the S.A.S. must issue the factura electrónica de venta through an authorized software or service provider, transmit the invoice in real time to DIAN's validation web services/API before delivery to the purchaser, and include the DIAN-generated digital validation code (digital stamping). The invoice must also be made available to the consumer through a digital channel or QR code, and the seller must retain the electronic invoice record with the DIAN imputation for fiscal audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Colombia are excluded from IVA and qualify for zero-ratification provided the exporter holds a valid customs export declaration and proves the goods have left Colombian customs territory. Services rendered by the specialty tea salon may qualify as exempt/zero-rated if they are genuinely provided to non-residents or used exclusively abroad, such as digital platform services or consultancy related to international distribution, subject to Article 481 of the Estatuto Tributario and applicable DIAN interpretive rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) submitted electronically through DIAN customs systems
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of the goods from Colombia
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas) issued by an authorized Colombian foreign exchange intermediary, evidencing collection in the established term
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit export-supported VAT refunds for up to five taxable years; any misstatement, fictitious export, or fraudulent documentation triggers revocation of the zero-rating and of any refund, reclassification of the transaction as locally taxable, default interest, penalties of up to 200% on improperly obtained refunds or compensations, and potential criminal liability for tax fraud and customs smuggling. Retrospective clawback also applies where the exporter fails to maintain the underlying commercial and transport documentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Junta Directiva del Banco de la República); exchange-control supervision exercised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) over Authorized Intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario – IMCs) and enforcement/penalty assessment by the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); legal basis: Constitución Política de Colombia (1991), Ley 31/1992, Estatuto Cambiario (Decreto 1735/1993), and Resolución Externa 8/2000 (Régimen de Cambios Internacionales).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is fully convertible for current-account transactions (imports, exports, services, transfers) and for most capital-account transactions without prior government authorization, but every regulated operation must be settled exclusively through an IMC and evidenced by an exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio). Inbound FDI in an S.A.S. is free, but must be channeled and registered in Formulario No. 3 to preserve profit-remittance and capital-repatriation rights; unregistered or off-market investment is 'descanalizada' and cannot legally exit through the FX market. Profit remittance hurdles: (i) funds must be legally registered FDI, (ii) profits must be evidenced by audited/filed financial statements and shareholder meeting minutes, (iii) dividend remittances require a Formulario No. 3 declaration and are subject to 10% non-resident dividend withholding tax (plus the underlying 35% inflationary? No, don't add tax) – hence all treasury intents should carry underlying documentation. External credits from non-resident shareholders are equally allowed but must satisfy the external-debt registration and term/interest rules of Decreto 1735/1993 and Resolución 8/2000; a compulsory reserve deposit (encaje) may be reinstated when ordered by the Junta Directiva (currently not active).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must 'canalize' 100% of export proceeds through the Colombian FX market: for goods, within 6 months from the date of shipment (fecha de embarque); for services (relevant if the SAS bills foreign clients for software or lounge consulting), within 6 months from the invoice maturity date of the service. Fulfillment may be by (a) sale of the foreign currency to an IMC for COP, or (b) deposit into a foreign-currency checking/savings account at an IMC in Colombia, in both cases filing Formulario No. 2 (goods) or Formulario No. 5 (services). Retention abroad requires a previously authorized compensation account (cuenta de compensación) granted by the Banco de la República in exceptional cases. Late or partial channeling is an exchange infraction sanctionable by DIAN with fines and the loss of the right to use the official FX market for the uncovered amount.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente COP) for payroll/POS/supplier rails, complemented by a USD Foreign-Currency Deposit Account (Cuenta en Moneda Extranjera) for FDI inflow and import settlements
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente COP) plus foreign-currency deposit sub-account; strong trade finance desk for tea/ceramic import LCs
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente COP) and merchant acquiring integration with Redeban; additional USD account for cross-border receipts
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente COP) with digital API treasury services; USD account available under global BBVA KYC
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente COP) for mid-market corporate clients with tangential cross-border capability
Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente COP) and foreign-currency account; strong for upper-mid-market clients only

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as primary treasury rail: offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, Airwallex) hold no Colombian IMC license, cannot issue local COP account numbers, cannot settle POS/credit-card merchant funds in COP, and are not accepted by DIAN/Banco de la República for Formulario declaration purposes. Permitted only as ancillary offshore receivable channels, provided all funds are immediately re-channeled (recanalización) into the Colombian IMC account within the term prescribed by Resolución 8/2000 to avoid descanalización penalties. Regulated onshore fintech alternative: SEDPES (Sociedades Especializadas en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos, e.g., Nequi, Daviplata) may serve as low-value e-money wallets and POS collection taps, but they do not replace the IMC bank account for cross-border FX or corporate disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Standard Colombian corporate onboarding requires an in-branch interview: the legal representative (or, for non-resident shareholders, the local attorney-in-fact holding an apostilled notarial power of attorney translated into Spanish by an official translator) must appear personally for biometric capture and original-signature verification. Fully remote openings are not standard for S.A.S. accounts; remote processes are accepted only for subsequent product additions after the physical KYC file is completed. Core KYC pack: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (Camara de Comercio, issued within 90 days), RUT (Registro Único Tributario de DIAN), estatutos y actas de constitución, identification documents of all directors and UBOs, proof of registered address, opening capital evidence, and Sarlaft risk questionnaire (per Circular Básica Jurídica, SFC Circular Externa 029/2014).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident indirect ownership chain with shell-like intermediate jurisdictions (e.g., Panama/BVI) – automatic UBO escalation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO map down to natural-person shareholders; apostilled certificates of incumbency/existence for each intermediate entity; bank references from the originating foreign bank; source-of-wealth declaration for the foreign investors; Sarlaft anti-money-laundering self-assessment; commitment to disclose annual shareholder movements in the Libro de Accionistas.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Apparent contradiction between the constitutional corporate purpose (specialty tea salon/ISIC 5630) and actual technology-nearshoring revenue flows detected in foreign wire pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amended bylaws (reforma de estatutos) expressly electing a broad objeto social that includes both 'comercialización de tés, salones de té y actividades conexas' and 'prestación de servicios tecnológicos, desarrollo de software y centros de servicio digital'; master services agreements and invoices; local business license (registro de industria y comercio); lease contract of the salon; supplier purchase contracts; organizational charts reflecting both business lines.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capitalization disproportionately high versus the 5630 micro-retail profile, plus shareholder loan (crédito externo) mixing with equity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Constitution minutes (acta de constitución/estatutos) documenting the share subscription and paid-in capital; bank credit slips evidencing channeling through the IMC; Formulario No. 3 FDI registration; for shareholder loans: written loan agreement with market-rate interest, term ≥ 1 year (per external-credit rules), and Formulario No. 4 declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensive point-of-sale operations generating frequent cash deposits inconsistent with invoice declarations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant acquiring contracts with Redeban/Credibanco; POS settlement statements and daily Z-reports; cash register logbook; VAT/ICA monthly declarations cross-referencing revenue; treasury policy separating merchant settlements from cash drops; cash-trail documentation for any receipts above USD 10,000 equivalent triggering DNFBP reporting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FX operations (import of tea/ceramics, dividend remittances) without a documented commercial underlying.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Import purchase orders, international commercial invoices, waybills/Bill of Lading; Exchange declarations Formulario 1 (imports), Formulario 2 (exports of goods), Formulario 5 (services); KYC of suppliers with supplier bank details on file; document retention for 10 years per statutory retention for exchange and tax evidence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the mercantile registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Chamber of Commerce of the company's registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio), subject to oversight by the Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March; fixed calendar deadline for the calendar year, not anniversary-based
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal surcharge and default interest set under Chamber tariff; continuous failure triggers inactivation of the merchant registration and may lead to administrative strike-off/cancellation of the commercial registry, preventing lawful commercial activity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual financial statements (Estados Financieros, notas y dictamen del Revisor Fiscal if applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Chamber of Commerce of the registered domicile; Superintendencia de Sociedades where the S.A.S. is subject to permanent supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual; financial statements for the 31 December year-end must be approved by the shareholders' meeting no later than 31 March of the following year and filed with the Chamber within one month after approval (by 30 April in practice).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-deposit blocks the annual mercantile renewal and exposes the company and legal representatives to Chamber/Superintendencia fines; persistent non-compliance can lead to loss of good standing and administrative strike-off of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax and complementary return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually under DIAN's published tax calendar; for an S.A.S. with a 31 December fiscal year, filing windows generally fall between July and September of the following year, determined by the final digit of the NIT.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% per partial or full month on the greater of tax due, capped under the Tax Code, plus default interest; repeated failure enables DIAN default assessment and suspension of the RUT, affecting ability to operate, invoice, or obtain public certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-ownership update (Reporte/Actualización de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual; deadlines set by DIAN resolution, currently by 30 September of each calendar year; supplementary update required upon substantial change in ownership or control after the annual report.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: UVT-denominated information penalties for non-filing, late filing, or misstatement; inaccurate or missing beneficial ownership records may trigger tax-audit sanctions and impair reliance on the S.A.S.'s corporate and tax status.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For a Colombian S.A.S., an independent statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is compulsory under Código de Comercio Article 203 and Decree 2420/2015 when total gross assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV or gross income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV in the preceding year; mandatory also where the State holds 20% or more of the share capital or where group consolidation rules require it. SMMLV is re-indexed annually.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian accounting regulation adopts IFRS by Law 1314/2009 and Decree 2420/2015/Decree 2496/2015; an unlisted specialty tea salon S.A.S. is ordinarily classified as Group 2 (IFRS for SMEs) or Group 3 (micro-entity simplified standards), with obligation to apply full IFRS if listed or of public interest.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: In a Colombian S.A.S., every share transfer must be executed and entered in the shareholder register (Libro de Registro de Accionistas) to be enforceable against the company and third parties. The annual mercantile renewal must reflect the current shareholder and capital structure; in parallel, the company must update the DIAN Beneficiario Final module so that the natural-person beneficial owner(s) are correctly reported by the annual due date after any shareholding transfer.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members/Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Board Minutes (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
General Meeting Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Statutory Accounting Books (Libro Diario and Libro Mayor)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250–700 per year for registered-office or local corporate-agent/mailing services in Bogotá or other large Colombian cities; nil if the S.A.S. uses its own commercial premises as registered address.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–4,500 for an independent audit or Revisor Fiscal under IFRS for SMEs, depending on transaction volume, asset complexity, and whether the statutory audit threshold is exceeded.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 34% federal general rate for tax year 2025 (35% for 2023-2024; declining to 33% in 2026 and 32% from 2027 under Law 2277 of 2022, as amended).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Optional SIMPLE combined regime (1.8%-14.5% of gross receipts, replacing CIT, VAT duties and ICA, for entities with gross revenues up to 80,000 UVT); 30% additional deduction for new fixed productive assets (art. 158-3 ET); 100% VAT on fixed productive assets creditable against CIT (art. 258-1 ET); no discretionary tax holidays; dividends received from Colombian subsidiaries remain exempt at the recipient under the imputation system.
